envelope: GET returns object directly; lists are {items:[...],total:N}

GET /api/capabilities.realCollector: Linux sandbox: CPU, memory, root filesystem, OS only

body.text: 1..2000 UTF-8 bytes after trim; raw request maximum 4096 bytes

response.managerStartedAt: RFC3339 process epoch, not a credential

POST /api/dev/telemetry.guards: same exact Host/Origin/CSRF/JSON guard as local settings; no device authentication claim
POST /api/dev/telemetry.storage: ephemeral only; fixed Linux sandbox role; no enrollment, credential storage, or direct-collector fallback

endpoints.POST /api/enrollment/invitations: Optional guided-v2 exclusive LAN mode; see docs/enrollment-v2/http-contract.md
endpoints.POST /api/enrollment/{invitationId}/appr: Optional guided-v2 exclusive LAN mode; see docs/enrollment-v2/http-contract.md
endpoints.POST /api/enrollment/{invitationId}/term: Optional guided-v2 exclusive LAN mode; see docs/enrollment-v2/http-contract.md
endpoints.POST /v2/enrollment/challenge: Optional guided-v2 exclusive LAN mode; see docs/enrollment-v2/http-contract.md
endpoints.POST /v2/enrollment/claim: Optional guided-v2 exclusive LAN mode; see docs/enrollment-v2/http-contract.md
endpoints.POST /v2/enrollment/status: Optional guided-v2 exclusive LAN mode; see docs/enrollment-v2/http-contract.md
endpoints.POST /v2/enrollment/credential: Optional guided-v2 exclusive LAN mode; see docs/enrollment-v2/http-contract.md
endpoints.POST /v2/enrollment/activate: Optional guided-v2 exclusive LAN mode; see docs/enrollment-v2/http-contract.md

GET /api/devices/{id}/operational.authentication: existing operator session in LAN mode
GET /api/devices/{id}/operational.collection: read-only stored observations; no collection or provider calls

security: Loopback bind+Host allowlist+no CORS+Origin checks+CSRF for mutations; no remote auth/enrollment; not production security.
qualitySemantics: Metric/Evidence quality healthy means current valid observation, not low severity or endpoint health. Source synthetic is simulated; sandbox has deliberately unknown overall device status.

cli.agent --once: Single local Device as JSON on stdout; no transport
cli.agent --support-bundle: Versioned schema tracebolt.support.v1; stdout only, max65536 bytes; docs/support-bundle.schema.json
cli.lan-agent --config PATH --foreground --i: Linux bounded foreground reports with exclusive durable ledger and retry/backoff; no OS service installation.

ruleScope: V1 deterministic rules accept only explicitly synthetic fixtures. Native local observations are not automatically turned into cases.
managedPreview: Explicitly default-off. Disables both initial and periodic manager-side collection. Only a separate dev-agent delivery updates sandbox-local. Expiry preserves old values as stale and never asserts continuous process availability.
deploymentModes: Development remains loopback-only. Separate lan-manager supports manual-v1 or explicit guided-v2 identity mode; docs/lan-runtime.md and docs/enrollment-v2/runtime-config.md define trust/custody requirements. No automatic mode migration.
